superseded_candidates.superseded_reason: lane rebased onto repaired governance base and active-source binding defect fixed

change_scope: migration provenance classification, parity CI, and an operator recovery tool. No migration was added, applied, replayed, or altered; no production data was mutated.

review_remediation.finding: normalizeSql() collapsed whitespace globally, including inside single-quoted string literals and dollar-quoted function bodies
review_remediation.consequence: two migrations inserting different data, or defining different routine bodies, could normalize to the same string and compare as equal
review_remediation.resolution: the helper was deleted, not repaired
review_remediation.justification: it was never wired into the parity gate, which has always used exact SHA-256 comparison, so no parity result was ever produced by it; a dead module with a subtle false-equality bug is a trap for the next reader who imports it assuming it is sound
review_remediation.comparison_basis_now: exact bytes, modulo trailing whitespace only, which fails loudly toward human classification rather than silently declaring different migrations identical

active_source_binding_defect.finding: check_migration_parity.mjs discovered the active migration source but never bound it to the manifest entry, so a version present in supabase/migrations could be classified 'missing', or have its manifest source_path redirected to another existing file, and the gate still passed
active_source_binding_defect.resolution: every version present in the active migration directory must now have a manifest entry that is not 'missing', whose source_path equals the exact active path and whose source_sha256 equals the exact active bytes; an active version with no manifest entry is also rejected

recovery_posture.reason: live migration bodies can embed direct identifiers, so copying all 68 into source control would re-import data that was deliberately removed

remaining_gates: independent review of this exact candidate head
operator-run materialization of the 53 missing migrations with privacy sanitization where blocked
authoring and reviewing down-migrations: no applied migration has rollback metadata at the provider
